crossRefs.note: Therefore Yahweh, the God of Israel, says against the shepherds who feed my people: “You have scattered my flock…

translations.web: As for the prophet, the priest, and the people, who say, ‘The message from Yahweh,’ I will even punish that man and his household.
translations.bsb: As for the prophet or priest or anyone who claims, ‘This is the burden of the LORD,’ I will punish that man and his household.
translations.kjv: And as for the prophet, and the priest, and the people, that shall say, The burden of the LORD, I will even punish that man and his house.
translations.asv: And as for the prophet, and the priest, and the people, that shall say, The burden of Jehovah, I will even punish that man and his house.
